title: चत्वारिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Yudhishthira, free of his grief, is seated on a golden seat and consecrated with water from the holy rivers, and the people honour him as king. He receives the kingdom with Dhritarashtra's permission and rules with Bhima as heir.
summary.kn: ಶೋಕ ಕಳೆದ ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರ ಚಿನ್ನದ ಪೀಠದಲ್ಲಿ ಕುಳಿತು ಪವಿತ್ರ ನದಿಗಳ ನೀರಿನಿಂದ ಅಭಿಷಿಕ್ತನಾಗುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಪ್ರಜೆಗಳು ರಾಜನಾಗಿ ಗೌರವಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಧೃತರಾಷ್ಟ್ರನ ಅನುಮತಿಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ರಾಜ್ಯ ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸಿ ಭೀಮ ಯುವರಾಜನಾಗಿ ಆಳುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: शोकमुक्त युधिष्ठिर स्वर्ण आसन पर बैठकर पवित्र नदियों के जल से अभिषिक्त होते हैं और प्रजा राजा के रूप में उनका सम्मान करती है। वे धृतराष्ट्र की अनुमति से राज्य ग्रहण कर भीम को युवराज बनाकर शासन करते हैं।
summary.te: శోకం తీరిన యుధిష్ఠిరుడు బంగారు పీఠంపై కూర్చుని పవిత్ర నదుల జలంతో అభిషిక్తుడవుతాడు; ప్రజలు రాజుగా గౌరవిస్తారు. ధృతరాష్ట్రుని అనుమతితో రాజ్యం స్వీకరించి భీముని యువరాజుగా చేసి పాలిస్తాడు.
summary.ta: துயர் நீங்கிய யுதிஷ்டிரர் பொன்னாசனத்தில் அமர்ந்து புனித நதிகளின் நீரால் முடிசூட்டப்படுகிறார்; மக்கள் அவரை மன்னராக மதிக்கின்றனர். த்ருதராஷ்டிரனின் அனுமதியுடன் அரசை ஏற்று பீமனை இளவரசராக்கி ஆள்கிறார்.
summary.ml: ദുഃഖം വിട്ടൊഴിഞ്ഞ യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ സ്വർണ്ണ സിംഹാസനത്തിലിരുന്നു, പുണ്യനദികളിലെ ജലത്താൽ അഭിഷേകം ചെയ്യപ്പെടുന്നു; ജനങ്ങൾ അദ്ദേഹത്തെ രാജാവായി ആദരിക്കുന്നു. ധൃതരാഷ്ട്രരുടെ അനുമതിയോടെ അദ്ദേഹം രാജ്യം ഏറ്റെടുക്കുന്നു; ഭീമൻ അവകാശിയായി ഭരണം നടത്തുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 12.40; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Wed Jun 16 2021

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
ततः कुन्तीसुतो राजा गतमन्युर्गतज्वरः ।
काञ्चने प्राङ्मुखो हृष्टो न्यषीदत्परमासने ॥

meaning.en: Then King Yudhishthira, Kunti's son, free of anger and fever, sat delighted facing east on a golden throne.

verses.text:
तमेवाभिमुखौ पीठे सेव्यास्तरणसंवृते ।
सात्यकिर्वासुदेवश्च निषीदतुररिंदमौ ॥

meaning.en: Facing him on a seat covered with a fine spread sat Satyaki and Vasudeva, subduers of foes.

verses.text:
मध्ये कृत्वा तु राजानं भीमसेनार्जुनावुभौ ।
निषीदतुर्महात्मानौ श्लक्ष्णयोर्मणिपीठयोः ॥

meaning.en: Placing the king between them, the two great souls Bhimasena and Arjuna sat on smooth jewelled seats.

verses.text:
दान्ते शय्यासने शुभ्रे जाम्बूनदविभूषिते ।
पृथापि सहदेवेन सहास्ते नकुलेन च ॥

meaning.en: On a shining couch of ivory adorned with Jambunada gold sat Pritha with Sahadeva and Nakula.

verses.text:
सुधर्मा विदुरो धौम्यो धृतराष्ट्रश्च कौरवः ।
निषेदुर्ज्वलनाकारेष्वासनेषु पृथक्पृथक् ॥

meaning.en: Sudharma, Vidura, Dhaumya and King Dhritarashtra of the Kurus each sat on seats blazing like flame.

verses.text:
युयुत्सुः संजयश्चैव गान्धारी च यशस्विनी ।
धृतराष्ट्रो यतो राजा ततः सर्व उपाविशन् ॥

meaning.en: Yuyutsu, Sanjaya and the renowned Gandhari sat there, and all sat near where King Dhritarashtra was.

verses.text:
तत्रोपविष्टो धर्मात्मा श्वेताः सुमनसोऽस्पृशत् ।
स्वस्तिकानक्षतान्भूमिं सुवर्णं रजतं मणीन् ॥

meaning.en: Seated there, the righteous king touched white flowers, svastika signs, unbroken rice, earth, gold, silver and jewels.

verses.text:
ततः प्रकृतयः सर्वाः पुरस्कृत्य पुरोहितम् ।
ददृशुर्धर्मराजानमादाय बहु मङ्गलम् ॥

meaning.en: Then all the subjects, with the family priest at their head, came bringing many auspicious things and saw Dharmaraja.

verses.text:
पृथिवीं च सुवर्णं च रत्नानि विविधानि च ।
आभिषेचनिकं भाण्डं सर्वसंभारसंभृतम् ॥

meaning.en: They brought earth, gold and various jewels, and the vessels for consecration filled with all materials.

verses.text:
काञ्चनौदुम्बरास्तत्र राजताः पृथिवीमयाः ।
पूर्णकुम्भाः सुमनसो लाजा बर्हींषि गोरसाः ॥

meaning.en: There were pitchers of gold, udumbara wood, silver and clay, full of water, with flowers, parched grain, kusha grass and milk products.

verses.text:
शमीपलाशपुंनागाः समिधो मधुसर्पिषी ।
स्रुव औदुम्बरः शङ्खास्तथा हेमविभूषिताः ॥

meaning.en: There were sticks of shami, palasha and punnaga wood, honey and ghee, an udumbara ladle, and conches adorned with gold.

verses.text:
दाशार्हेणाभ्यनुज्ञातस्तत्र धौम्यः पुरोहितः ।
प्रागुदक्प्रवणां वेदीं लक्षणेनोपलिप्य ह ॥

meaning.en: With Dasharha's leave, the priest Dhaumya there smeared the altar, sloping toward the north-east, with the proper plaster.

verses.text:
व्याघ्रचर्मोत्तरे श्लक्ष्णे सर्वतोभद्र आसने ।
दृढपादप्रतिष्ठाने हुताशनसमत्विषि ॥

meaning.en: On a smooth seat, auspicious in every way, spread with a tiger skin, with firm legs and blazing like fire,

verses.text:
उपवेश्य महात्मानं कृष्णां च द्रुपदात्मजाम् ।
जुहाव पावकं धीमान्विधिमन्त्रपुरस्कृतम् ॥

meaning.en: he seated the great soul and Draupadi Krishna, daughter of Drupada, and the wise priest poured oblations into the fire, led by rite and mantra.

verses.text:
अभ्यषिञ्चत्पतिं पृथ्व्याः कुन्तीपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम् ।
धृतराष्ट्रश्च राजर्षिः सर्वाः प्रकृतयस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: Then Dhritarashtra the royal sage and all the subjects consecrated Yudhishthira, Kunti's son, lord of the earth.

verses.text:
ततोऽनुवादयामासुः पणवानकदुन्दुभीः ।
धर्मराजोऽपि तत्सर्वं प्रतिजग्राह धर्मतः ॥

meaning.en: Then they had drums, tabors and kettledrums sounded, and Dharmaraja accepted all that according to dharma.

verses.text:
पूजयामास तांश्चापि विधिवद्भूरिदक्षिणः ।
ततो निष्कसहस्रेण ब्राह्मणान्स्वस्ति वाचयत् ।
वेदाध्ययनसंपन्नाञ्शीलवृत्तसमन्वितान् ॥

meaning.en: Giving generous fees, he honored them properly, and with a thousand gold coins he had the brahmins pronounce blessings, learned in the Veda, of good character and conduct.

verses.text:
ते प्रीता ब्राह्मणा राजन्स्वस्त्यूचुर्जयमेव च ।
हंसा इव च नर्दन्तः प्रशशंसुर्युधिष्ठिरम् ॥

meaning.en: Those pleased brahmins said "Blessings" and "Victory," and roaring like swans, they praised Yudhishthira.

verses.text:
युधिष्ठिर महाबाहो दिष्ट्या जयसि पाण्डव ।
दिष्ट्या स्वधर्मं प्राप्तोऽसि विक्रमेण महाद्युते ॥

meaning.en: "Mighty-armed Yudhishthira, by good fortune you have conquered, Pandava; by good fortune you have gained your own dharma by valor, radiant one.

verses.text:
दिष्ट्या गाण्डीवधन्वा च भीमसेनश्च पाण्डवः ।
त्वं चापि कुशली राजन्माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ ॥

meaning.en: By good fortune the wielder of Gandiva and Bhimasena the Pandava, and you also, king, and the two sons of Madri are well.

verses.text:
मुक्ता वीरक्षयादस्मात्संग्रामान्निहतद्विषः ।
क्षिप्रमुत्तरकालानि कुरु कार्याणि पाण्डव ॥

meaning.en: Freed from this destruction of heroes, this battle, with your enemies slain, quickly do what must be done afterward, Pandava."

verses.text:
ततः प्रत्यर्चितः सद्भिर्धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः ।
प्रतिपेदे महद्राज्यं सुहृद्भिः सह भारत ॥

meaning.en: Then, honored in return by the good, Dharmaraja Yudhishthira took up the great kingdom with his friends, Bharata.
